title: Test-retest reproducibility analysis of lung CT image features

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Test-retest reproducibility analysis of lung CT image features》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Quantitative size, shape, and texture features derived from computed tomographic (CT) images may be useful as predictive, prognostic, or response biomarkers in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

evidence.text: Quantitative size, shape, and texture features derived from computed tomographic (CT) images may be useful as predictive, prognostic, or response biomarkers in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Test-retest reproducibility analysis of lung CT image features》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】Thirty-two patients with NSCLC were subjected to unenhanced thoracic CT scans acquired within 15 min of each other under an approved protocol.

【Abstract · abstract-1-13】Test-retest and correlation analyses have identified non-redundant CT image features with both high intra-patient reproducibility and inter-patient biological range.

evidence.text: Thirty-two patients with NSCLC were subjected to unenhanced thoracic CT scans acquired within 15 min of each other under an approved protocol.
Test-retest and correlation analyses have identified non-redundant CT image features with both high intra-patient reproducibility and inter-patient biological range.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Test-retest reproducibility analysis of lung CT image features》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-10】These reproducible features were found to be predictive of radiological prognosis.

【Abstract · abstract-1-11】The area under the curve (AUC) was 91% for a size-based feature and 92% for the texture features (runlength, laws).

evidence.text: These reproducible features were found to be predictive of radiological prognosis.
The area under the curve (AUC) was 91% for a size-based feature and 92% for the texture features (runlength, laws).
